metric_definitions.macro_food_iou: global confusion-matrix IoU averaged over WED food classes present in the fixed DEV carve
metric_definitions.boundary_f1: class-wise semantic-mask boundaries with a 3-pixel tolerance at original DEV resolution
metric_definitions.tiny_bin: WED GT 8-connected per-class semantic components under 0.10% of image area
metric_definitions.component_recall: same-class one-to-one Hungarian component match at IoU >= 0.5
metric_definitions.region_f1: same-class one-to-one Hungarian component precision/recall/F1 at IoU >= 0.5
metric_definitions.bootstrap: 10,000 paired resamples of the same 21 physical meal groups; differences averaged across three trained seeds
